text:
kim_sales: Heads up 10 GreenHaven procurement sent their final PO template. They require: separate invoice per legal entity, PO number on every invoice line, bank remit info on each invoice, and MSA signed prior to any billing. Can we map to our order flow?
elena_legal: MSA-first is acceptable. Need clarification on signer roles per subsidiary (some will have local counsels). They attached a DPA with extra KMS/HSM bullets 12 we should redline.
toni_cs: POC is Dedicated (30d) then converts to reserved commit. Procurement also insists on a POC credit line so they don't get auto-billed.
ravi_ops: We can output multiple invoices by billing_entity_id and include a po_number + po_line_id on each line. Will need a small schema field addition: add "po_line_ref" and "remit_label" to invoice payload. Ops ETA: 1 business day to update schema + 1 day to QA templates.
carla_finance: Finance standard: net30 + deposit (25%) for Reserved pilots. Customer asks for net45, no deposit. Finance would accept net45 only if deposit >= 30% or a payment guarantee.
kim_sales: They also want a 12-month price hold for the SKUs listed. We verbally committed price stability for 6 months only. Need legal + finance on any extended lock.
elena_legal: Draft HSM redline suggestion: 
```
Customer-Managed KMS/HSM: Customer may supply keys or HSM references. Redwood will not have access to private key material. Integration subject to security review; audit scope for keys is mutually agreed. Liability limited to gross negligence/willful misconduct.
```
If procurement pushes broader indemnity, escalate to counsel.
toni_cs: I'll add explicit order form line: "POC credit (one-time) -$X" so billing flags it and does not auto-invoice.
ravi_ops: DocuSign routing thought: single consolidated MSA envelope (all execs/legal reps sign once) then per-entity order form envelopes referencing the MSA ID. That yields separate signed documents for each entity and matches invoice split. Use envelope subjects like: "MSA 1 GH Consolidated" and "GH-US Order Form (billing: GH-US)".
carla_finance: Proposed deposit schedule for net45: 30% due at countersign, remainder invoiced day 1 net45. If legal signs off, finance can approve net45 for pilot with that deposit.
kim_sales: Procurement also wants PO binding on day 0 and a clause that each PO line locks SKU pricing. Add explicit PO clause on order form.
elena_legal: Legal action: finalize HSM redline and produce a short signer mapping table: Exec -> MSA, Procurement -> Order Form, Finance -> PO ack. Will add subprocessor list + SOC2 as attachments.
toni_cs: I'll prepare cover note and attach SOC2 + subprocessor PDF to both MSA+order envelopes. Add a short statement: "Subprocessors and audit scope attached as requested."
ds-bot: docusign: template created (tmpl-gh-multi-v2). Please review signers and ensure per-entity placeholders exist.
ravi_ops: Billing change snippet (for implementers): 
```
order_lines: [ { sku: "dedicated-gpu-month", qty: 1, billing_entity_id: "GH-US", po_number: "PO-98765", po_line_ref: "PO-98765-1" } ],
invoice_meta: { remit_label: "GH-US - ACH xxxxx", po_bound_on_day0: true }
```
Ops will add masking on bank details when generating PDFs.
carla_finance: Once legal approves the redline and signer mapping, finance will sign off on net45 + 30% deposit.
kim_sales: Action items: 1) @elena_legal finalize HSM redline + signer map (EOD), 2) @ravi_ops ship invoice schema + DocuSign template updates (1 business day), 3) @carla_finance confirm deposit language, 4) @toni_cs attach SOC2/subprocessors and prepare envelopes.
ds-bot: envelope created (env-gh-9009) for MSA; template shows placeholders for subsidiary execs. kim_sales: please QA and confirm before send.
kim_sales: Reviewing now, will post final order form + PO line mapping in this thread before sending. :thumbsup:
